name: Pink Moon Club
source:
Loud music fills your surroundings as the flashy lights envelop you, making it feel like you're in a different dimension. Stepping through the doors of the Pink Moon Club for the first time, a gay bar notorious for its popularity among certain types of clients, you'll find a wide menu of drinks available. With so many choices, you'll have plenty of options for your drunken night out. So, who or what will you be spending your night with?
